name: Exp_i-CAi
summary: This EA trades based on the custom i-CAi indicator, which is a smoothed moving average crossover system. It opens buy positions when the indicator values turn upward and sell positions when they turn downward, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义i-CAi指标进行交易，i-CAi是一个平滑移动平均交叉系统。当指标值转向上时开多仓，转向下时开空仓，具有可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于i-CAi自定义指标的方向变化判断趋势转折，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>=Value[1]时开多仓，表示指标从下降转为上升，趋势向上启动；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<=Value[1]时开空仓，表示指标从上升转为下降，趋势向下启动。出场条件依赖固定止损止盈（默认1000点止损、2000点止盈），同时支持反向信号平仓——开多信号触发空仓平仓，开空信号触发多仓平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、含浮亏自由保证金比例、含浮亏余额比例和固定手数，通过MM和MMMode参数控制。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库的标准化交易函数，支持滑点控制（默认10点）和买卖开关独立控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional changes in the custom i-CAi indicator to identify trend reversals, making it a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>=Value[1], indicating the indicator has turned from declining to rising and an uptrend is starting; a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<=Value[1], indicating the indicator has turned from rising to declining and a downtrend is starting. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), while also supporting reverse signal closures — a buy signal triggers closing of sell positions and a sell signal triggers closing of buy positions. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, free margin with floating loss, balance with floating loss, and fixed lot size, controlled by the MM and MMMode parameters. Money management uses standardized trading functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, with slippage control (default 10 points) and independent buy/sell enable switches.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, controls trade lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/含浮亏等
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: Fixed lot or margin-based ratio

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑相位参数，影响JJMA/VIDYA/AMA行为
parameters.description_en: Smoothing phase parameter, affects JJMA/VIDYA/AMA behavior

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 指标计算所用价格类型

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号计算使用的K线索引

pros: 支持10种平滑算法，策略灵活性高，可根据品种特性选择最优平滑方式
反向信号自动平仓机制，能及时结束逆势持仓，减少回撤
买卖开关独立控制，可灵活配置只做多或只做空，适应不同市场环境
支持5种仓位管理模式，从保守到激进均可覆盖
使用新K线检测避免同根K线重复交易，逻辑严谨
pros_en: Supports 10 smoothing algorithms providing high strategy flexibility to match instrument characteristics
Reverse signal auto-close mechanism promptly ends counter-trend positions, reducing drawdown
Independent buy/sell enable switches allow configuring long-only or short-only to suit market conditions
Five position sizing modes cover conservative to aggressive money management approaches
New bar detection prevents duplicate trades within the same candle, ensuring logic integrity
cons: 依赖自定义i-CAi指标文件，缺少该文件则EA无法运行，部署依赖性强
止损1000点、止盈2000点默认值过大，在小周期或低波动品种上可能导致风险失控
没有浮亏限制和最大持仓控制，极端行情下可能持续加仓导致爆仓
SignalBar默认值为1时存在信号滞后问题，且值为0时跳过新K线检测可能产生重复信号
缺乏趋势过滤机制，在震荡市中可能频繁产生错误信号导致连续亏损
cons_en: Depends on the custom i-CAi indicator file; EA cannot run without it, creating strong deployment dependency
Default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, risking uncontrolled losses on low-volatility instruments
No floating loss limit or maximum position control; extreme market conditions could lead to unlimited exposure and account blow-up
SignalBar default of 1 causes signal lag, and value of 0 skips new bar detection potentially generating duplicate signals
Lacks trend filter mechanism, likely generating frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或大周期MA方向），避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓
增加最大浮亏限制和最大同时持仓数控制，防止极端行情下的过度风险暴露
根据品种ATR动态调整止损止盈，替代固定点数设置以适应不同波动率环境
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid frequent entries in ranging markets
Add maximum floating loss limit and maximum concurrent position count to prevent excessive risk exposure during extreme conditions
Use ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit instead of fixed point values to adapt to different volatility environments

risk_points: 默认止损1000点偏大，在低波动品种上风险敞口过高
没有最大持仓限制和浮亏保护，极端行情存在爆仓风险
依赖外部指标文件，指标缺失时初始化失败但无详细错误提示
risk_points_en: Default 1000-point stop loss is excessively large, creating oversized risk exposure on low-volatility instruments
No maximum position limit or floating loss protection poses account blow-up risk in extreme markets
Dependency on external indicator file causes initialization failure without detailed error guidance
